turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I need a new winter coat. My old one has a broken zipper.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Got it. Are you thinking a long warm parka, or a shorter jacket that's easier to move in?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold on, my friend and I need to figure something out. Wait until I'm back, okay?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, did you water the tomatoes this morning?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ethan, did you hear that noise?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I think it was the neighbors.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh no. They looked really droopy when I walked past.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'll do it now. Should I use the hose or the watering can?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The can, the hose is too strong for the seedlings next to them.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi again! Still deciding on the coat, long or short?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Long parka. I wait for the bus a lot and my legs freeze.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then go for one that reaches your knees with a good hood. Down or a synthetic fill both work well.
